terms.term: A class carrying @Weave that describes a change to one or more other classes. Without the annotation the class is ordinary, and every other Aether Weaver annotation on it is never read.
A class or interface a weave names with @Weave(value = ...) or @Weave(targets = ...), and the class the weaver modifies.
A method of a weave carrying @Inject, @Redirect or @Wrap. It is the method control is handed to at the position the declaration matched.
The module that supplies I/O and lifecycle around the engine: the Maven plugin, the agent, the class loader, the annotation processor or the testkit.
